source.title: The Diatessaron (Section 27)
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > The Diatessaron (Tatian) > Section 27

paragraphs.text: 1 {{BIBLE:mat 18:23}} Therefore the kingdom of heaven is like a certain king, who would make a 2 reckoning with his servants. {{BIBLE:mat 18:24}} And when he began to make it, they brought to him one who 3 owed him ten talents. {{BIBLE:mat 18:25}} And because he had not wherewith to pay, his lord ordered that he should be sold, he, and his wife, and children, and all that he 4 had, and payment be made. {{BIBLE:mat 18:26}} So that servant fell down and worshipped him, and said unto him, My lord, have patience with me, and I shall pay you everything. 5 {{BIBLE:mat 18:27}} And the lord of that servant had compassion, and released him, and forgave him his 6 debt. {{BIBLE:mat 18:28}} And that servant went out, and found one of his fellow- servants, who owed him [Arabic, p. 104] a hundred pence; and he took him, and dealt severely with him, and said 7 unto him, Give me what you owe. {{BIBLE:mat 18:29}} So the fellow-servant fell down at his 8 feet, and besought him, and said, Grant me respite, and I will pay you. {{BIBLE:mat 18:30}} And he would not; but took him, and cast him into prison, till he should give him his debt. 9 {{BIBLE:mat 18:31}} And when their fellow- servants saw what happened, it distressed them much; and 10 they came and told their lord of all that had taken place. {{BIBLE:mat 18:32}} Then his lord called him, and said unto him, You wicked servant, all that debt I forgave you, because 11 you besought me: {{BIBLE:mat 18:33}} was it not then incumbent on you also to have mercy on your 12 fellow-servant, as I had mercy on you? {{BIBLE:mat 18:34}} And his lord became angry, and delivered 13 him to the scourgers, till he should pay all that he owed. {{BIBLE:mat 18:35}} So shall my Father which is in heaven do unto you, if one forgive not his brother his wrong conduct from 14 his heart. {{BIBLE:luk 17:3}} Take heed within yourselves: if your brother sin, rebuke him; and if he 15 repent, forgive him. {{BIBLE:luk 17:4}} And if he act wrongly towards you seven times in a day, and on that day return seven times unto you, and say, I repent towards you; forgive him. 16 {{BIBLE:mat 18:15}} And if your brother act wrongly towards you, go and reprove him between you and 17 him alone: if he hear you, you have gained your brother. {{BIBLE:mat 18:16}} But if he hear you not, take with you one or two, and so at the mouth of two or three every saying shall 18 be established. {{BIBLE:mat 18:17}} And if he listen not to these also, tell the congregation; and if he listen not even to the congregation, let him be unto you as a publican and a Gentile. 19 {{BIBLE:mat 18:18}} Verily I say unto you, All that you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: 20 and what ye loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven. {{BIBLE:mat 18:19}} I say unto you also, If two of you agree on earth to ask, everything shall be granted them from my Father 21 [Arabic, p. 105] which is in heaven. {{BIBLE:mat 18:20}} For where two or three are gathered in my name, there 22 am I among them. {{BIBLE:mat 18:21}} Then Cephas drew near to him, and said unto him, My Lord, how many times, if my brother act wrongly towards me, should I forgive him? 23 until seven times? {{BIBLE:mat 18:22}} Jesus said unto him, I say not unto you, Until seven; but, Until seventy 24 times seven, seven. {{BIBLE:luk 12:47}} And the servant that knows his lord's will, and makes not 25 ready for him according to his will, shall meet with much punishment; {{BIBLE:luk 12:48}} but he that knows not, and does something for which he merits punishment, shall meet with slight punishment. Every one to whom much has been given, much shall be asked of him; and he that has had much committed to him, much shall be 26 required at his hand. {{BIBLE:luk 12:49}} I came to cast fire upon the earth; and I would that it had 27 been kindled already. {{BIBLE:luk 12:50}} And I have a baptism to be baptized with, and greatly am 28 I straitened till it be accomplished. {{BIBLE:mat 18:10}} See that you despise not one of these little ones that believe in me. Verily I say unto you, Their angels at all times see the 29 face of my Father which is in heaven. {{BIBLE:mat 18:11}} The Son of man came to save the thing which was lost.

30 {{BIBLE:joh 7:1}} And after that, Jesus walked in Galilee; and he did not like to walk in Judæa, 31 because the Jews sought to kill him. {{BIBLE:luk 13:1}} And there came people who told him of 32 the Galilæans, those whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices. {{BIBLE:luk 13:2}} Jesus answered and said unto them, Do ye imagine that those Galilæans were sinners 33 more than all the Galilæans, so that this thing has come upon them? {{BIBLE:luk 13:3}} Nay. Verily I say unto you now, that you shall all also, if you repent not, likewise perish. 34 {{BIBLE:luk 13:4}} Or perchance those eighteen on whom the palace fell in Siloam, and slew them, do ye imagine that they were to be condemned more than all the people that dwell 35 [Arabic, p. 106] in Jerusalem? Nay. {{BIBLE:luk 13:5}} Verily I say unto you, If you do not all repent, you shall perish like them.

36 {{BIBLE:luk 13:6}} And he spoke unto them this parable: A man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; 37 and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none. {{BIBLE:luk 13:7}} So he said to the husbandman, Lo, three years do I come and seek fruit on this fig tree, and find 38 none: cut it down; why does it render the ground unoccupied? {{BIBLE:luk 13:8}} The husbandman said unto him, My lord, leave it this year also, that I may dig about it, and dung 39 it; {{BIBLE:luk 13:9}} then if it bear fruit—! And if not, then cut it down in the coming year.

40 {{BIBLE:luk 13:10}} And when Jesus was teaching on the sabbath day in one of the synagogues, 41 there was there a woman that had a spirit of disease eighteen years; {{BIBLE:luk 13:11}} and she was 42 bowed down, and could not straighten herself at all. {{BIBLE:luk 13:12}} And Jesus saw her, and called 43 her, and said unto her, Woman, be loosed from your disease. {{BIBLE:luk 13:13}} And he put his hand 44 upon her; and immediately she was straightened, and praised God. {{BIBLE:luk 13:14}} And the chief of the synagogue answered with anger, because Jesus had healed on a sabbath, and said unto the multitudes, There are six days in which work ought to be done; 45 come in them and be healed, and not on the sabbath day. {{BIBLE:luk 13:15}} But Jesus answered and said unto him, You hypocrites, does not each of you on the sabbath day loose 46 his ox or his ass from the manger, and go and water it? {{BIBLE:luk 13:16}} Ought not this woman, who is a daughter of Abraham, and whom the devil has bound eighteen years, 47 to be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day? {{BIBLE:luk 13:17}} And when he said this, they were all put to shame, those standing, who were opposing him: and all the people were pleased with all the wonders that proceeded from his hand.

1 \BibleRef{玛 18:23} 因此，天国好比一个君王，要与他仆人结账。
ewline{}2 \BibleRef{玛 18:24} 开始结账时，有人带了一个欠他一万塔冷通的人来。
ewline{}3 \BibleRef{玛 18:25} 因他无力偿还，主人就下令把他和他的妻子儿女，并他所有的一切都卖掉来偿还。
ewline{}4 \BibleRef{玛 18:26} 那仆人跪下来叩拜\Emph{他}，说：\Quote{主啊，宽容我吧！我必将一切还清。}
ewline{}5 \BibleRef{玛 18:27} 那仆人的主人就动了怜悯的心，把他释放了，并且免了他的债。
ewline{}6 \BibleRef{玛 18:28} 但那仆人出去，遇见了一个欠他一百德纳的同伴，就抓住他，掐住他的喉咙说：\Quote{还清你欠的债！}（阿拉伯语抄本第104页）
ewline{}7 \BibleRef{玛 18:29} 那同伴俯伏在地求他说：\Quote{宽容我吧！我必要还你。}
ewline{}8 \BibleRef{玛 18:30} 他却不肯，且把他下在狱里，直到还清欠债。
ewline{}9 \BibleRef{玛 18:31} 其他同伴看见这事，非常悲伤，就去向主人报告了这一切。
ewline{}10 \BibleRef{玛 18:32} 于是主人叫了他来，对他说：\Quote{\Emph{你}这恶仆！因为你求我，我就免了你全部的债；
ewline{}11 \BibleRef{玛 18:33} 难道你不该也怜悯你的同伴，如同我怜悯你一样吗？}
ewline{}12 \BibleRef{玛 18:34} 主人就大怒，把他交给刑役，直到还清所欠的一切。
ewline{}13 \BibleRef{玛 18:35} 如果你们不从心里宽恕你们的弟兄，我的天父也必要这样对待你们。
ewline{}14 \BibleRef{路 17:3} 你们要谨慎！如果你的弟兄犯了罪，你就规劝他；如果他后悔了，就宽恕他。
ewline{}15 \BibleRef{路 17:4} 如果他一天七次得罪你，又七次转向你说：\Quote{我后悔了}，你也得宽恕他。
ewline{}16 \BibleRef{玛 18:15} 如果你的弟兄得罪了你，去，只在你们两人之间规劝他；如果他听从你，你便赚得了你的弟兄。
ewline{}17 \BibleRef{玛 18:16} 如果他不听，你就带一两个人去，这样凭两三个人的口供，一切事都可以成立。
ewline{}18 \BibleRef{玛 18:17} 如果连他们也不听，你就告诉教会；如果连教会也不听，你就把他看作外邦人或税吏。
ewline{}19 \BibleRef{玛 18:18} 我实在告诉你们：凡你们在地上束缚的，在天上也要被束缚；凡你们在地上释放的，在天上也要被释放。
ewline{}20 \BibleRef{玛 18:19} 我也告诉你们：如果你们中有两个人在地上同心合意地祈求，我在天之父必成全他们。
ewline{}21 \BibleRef{玛 18:20} 因为无论在哪里，有两三个人因我的名聚在一起，我就在他们中间。（阿拉伯语抄本第105页）
ewline{}22 \BibleRef{玛 18:21} 那时，\Person{刻法}走近耶稣说：\Quote{主啊！若我的弟兄得罪我，我该宽恕他多少次？直到七次吗？}
ewline{}23 \BibleRef{玛 18:22} 耶稣对他说：\Quote{我不对你说直到七次，而是到七十个七次。}
ewline{}24 \BibleRef{路 12:47} 那知道主人的旨意，却不预备，或不按他的意思做的仆人，必受许多鞭打；
ewline{}25 \BibleRef{路 12:48} 但那不知道的，做了该受鞭打的事，也必受轻打。凡多给谁，就向谁多取；多托付谁，就向谁多要。
ewline{}26 \BibleRef{路 12:49} 我来是把火投在地上，我是多么希望它已经燃烧起来！
ewline{}27 \BibleRef{路 12:50} 我有应受的圣洗，我是如何焦急，直到它完成！
ewline{}28 \BibleRef{玛 18:10} 你们小心，不要轻视这些小子中的一个，因为他们信从我。我实在告诉你们：他们的天使在天上，常见我在天之父的面。
ewline{}29 \BibleRef{玛 18:11} 人子来，是为拯救迷失的人。
latex.p0003:
30 \BibleRef{若 7:1} 此后，耶稣在加里肋亚行走；他不愿在犹太行走，因为犹太人想杀他。
ewline{}31 \BibleRef{路 13:1} 那时有人来告诉他关于加里肋亚人的事，就是比拉多把他们的血掺和在他们的祭品中。
ewline{}32 \BibleRef{路 13:2} 耶稣回答他们说：\Quote{你们以为这些加里肋亚人比其他加里肋亚人更有罪，才遭此祸吗？
ewline{}33 \BibleRef{路 13:3} 不是的。我告诉你们，如果你们不悔改，你们也要同样灭亡。
ewline{}34 \BibleRef{路 13:4} 或者，那些被史罗亚塔倒塌压死的十八个人，你们以为他们比住在耶路撒冷的其他居民更有罪吗？
ewline{}35 \BibleRef{路 13:5} 不是的。我告诉你们，如果你们不全都悔改，你们也要像他们一样灭亡。}
latex.p0005: 40 \BibleRef{路 13:10} 耶稣在安息日于一会堂中施教时，41 \BibleRef{路 13:11} 那里有一个妇人，被病魔缠身十八年；她佝偻着，完全不能直起腰来。42 \BibleRef{路 13:12} 耶稣看见她，便叫她过来，对她说：\Quote{妇人，你从疾病中解脱了。}43 \BibleRef{路 13:13} 遂按手在她身上；她立刻直起腰来，并光荣天主。44 \BibleRef{路 13:14} 会堂长因耶稣在安息日治病，便气忿忿地对群众说：\Quote{有六天应当工作；你们在这些日子里来求医，但不可在安息日。}45 \BibleRef{路 13:15} 耶稣却回答他说：\Quote{\Emph{你们}这些伪君子！你们每个人在安息日，难道不解开槽上的牛或驴，牵去饮水吗？46 \BibleRef{路 13:16} 这个妇人本是亚巴郎的女儿，被撒但捆绑了十八年，难道不该在安息日解开她的束缚吗？}47 \BibleRef{路 13:17} 他说这话时，所有反对他的人都感到惭愧；全体民众因他所行的一切奇事而欢喜。
